rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the creator of a book or other work.

example.english: Who is the author of this book?
example.traditional: 呢本書嘅作者係邊個呀？
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 zok3 ze2 hai6 bin1 go3 aa3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the person is a professional or literary book writer.

example.english: They are a well-known author who makes a living writing books.
example.traditional: 佢係一位出名嘅作家，靠寫書為生。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 ceot1 meng2 ge3 zok3 gaa1 kaau3 se2 syu1 wai4 sang1
